environment.description: Ktor 2.3.x microservice deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) with PostgreSQL 15 on RDS. The application container runs as root (UID 0) with the /data/documents volume mounted from an EFS share containing all tenant directories. The RDS database has RLS policies defined on the 'documents' table but the app_user role has the BYPASSRLS attribute granted for migration purposes. The pod's securityContext has no readOnlyRootFilesystem and no restrictions on file access. No network policy restricts egress. ALB ingress has no WAF attached.

config.rds_rls: POLICY exists but app_user has BYPASSRLS
